# Knowledge MCP servers

[← All categories](../README.md)

Retrieve or organize research, memory, and reference knowledge

| Server | Description | Transport | Project links |

| AccInt | Local-first Work Model and MCP server for coding-agent memory across Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and Cursor.
